name: add_tests_java_excel_column
description: Write plain-java tests (main + AssertionError) for an Excel column-name converter; java-native single-file mutation harness (no n-- off-by-one, no reverse, no throw)
prompts: ExcelColumn.name(int n) in ExcelColumn.java (already correct - do not modify it) converts a 1-indexed column number to its spreadsheet letter name: 1 -> A, 26 -> Z, 27 -> AA, 52 -> AZ, 53 -> BA, 703 -> AAA; any n < 1 throws IllegalArgumentException. Write a plain-Java test class at exactly ExcelColumnTest.java: a public static void main that checks EXACT expected strings (throw AssertionError with a helpful message on mismatch - no JUnit) covering at least: a single-letter value, the Z boundary and the AA rollover, a two-letter value beyond AZ, a three-letter value, and that name(0) throws IllegalArgumentException. The class must exit normally when everything passes.
